name: Enforce variant code invariants at construction
goal: Enforce Variant's existing code invariant during construction. Add init { validateCode(code) } inside the existing Variant class. Preserve its constructor, fields and existing methods. Add concise JUnit 5 regression tests inside VariantTest.
acceptance_criteria: Valid lowercase codes containing digits, underscores and hyphens are stored unchanged.
Two-character and 64-character codes are valid; one-character and 65-character codes throw IllegalArgumentException.
Empty and whitespace-only codes throw IllegalArgumentException.
Uppercase letters, embedded spaces and an at-sign in a code cause IllegalArgumentException.
Constructor input with surrounding spaces is rejected. The existing normalizeCode method still trims and lowercases explicitly.
Tests use JUnit 5 and the existing constructor. Keep all tests inside VariantTest and use a private helper to avoid repeated constructor arguments. No Spring context or database is required.
